concept.literalSynthesis: The vampire-spark wand (Жезл вампирской искры) is stitched into the cuff of the sewn vampire suit (Сшитый вампирский костюм), making a recognizable wand-and-garment combination: the cuff releases a falling red ember while the suit can be worn as an accessory.
concept.coreMechanic: Primary use fires one cursor-aimed magic ember for 12 base magic damage. It follows an authored gravity arc, has a 10×10 px hitbox, collides with tiles, lasts 1.5 seconds, and ends on its first NPC hit; a successful hit heals 10% of damage dealt, capped at 1 HP. The shot uses a 4-mana base cost and a 26-tick use interval/animation, preserving the wand parent's modest single-hit output and cadence while adding an explicit falling trajectory and on-hit siphon. The wearable accessory grants +2 defense, +1 HP/s life regeneration, and +5% movement speed. The latter two match the suit parent's passive regeneration and speed contribution; defense is a new authored benefit, not a parent fact or a holding bonus. Both parents have generation depth 0; rarity and value do not establish an acquisition tier, so no progression claim is made. The magic shot and its mana cost are a deliberate active benefit alongside the separately equipped passive package.
concept.parentAContribution: Жезл вампирской искры is a 12-damage magic wand with a 26-tick use interval, 4-mana cost, and a single cursor-aimed ember that has a gravity arc and heals its owner on a successful hit. Its focused wand identity supplies the active magic-ember action; this design keeps the source damage, timing, and mana cost and authors the gravity and capped healing directly.
concept.parentBContribution: Сшитый вампирский костюм is a sewn vampire-themed accessory whose source effects include life regeneration and movement speed. Its garment identity supplies the wearable passive role; the design retains +1 HP/s regeneration and +5% movement speed and adds +2 defense as a new explicit accessory effect.
concept.playerExperience: Use the wand-like cuff for a slow, mana-costing single ember with short reach and a small collision area; a hit returns at most 1 HP. Equip the mantle for its passive defense, regeneration, and speed. Those bonuses apply while equipped, not merely while held.

plannedPlayerActions.intent: Fire one cursor-aimed magic ember; its gravity arc and first-hit healing make each deliberate shot useful without increasing the parent's base damage or firing rate.
Wear the stitched garment as an accessory for defense, life regeneration, and movement speed while equipped.

realization.description: Primary use fires one cursor-aimed 12-base-damage magic ember from the owner, at 26.25 blocks/s. Gravity curves its path downward (27 blocks/s²); the 10×10 px projectile collides with tiles and lasts up to 1.5 seconds. On a damaging NPC hit it heals 10% of damage dealt, capped at 1 HP, and then ends after that first hit. The wand's base mana cost is 4, with a 26-tick use interval and animation. Equip the stitched mantle as an accessory for +2 defense, +1 HP/s life regeneration, and +5% movement speed. These accessory effects apply while equipped; holding the item grants no defense.
realization.playerExperience: This combines a modest single-hit magic shot with a small, capped healing return and a separate wearable survival bonus. The ember's short lifetime, small hitbox, first-hit termination, and mana cost reward deliberate aiming; the accessory passives have value only in an equipment slot.
